question: What preparatory ritual actions precede the recitation of the auspicious declaration?
premises: An altar is made with rice grains
The making of the altar is completed first
An auspicious declaration is then to be recited
inference: After making an altar with rice grains, one should have the auspicious declaration recited.
plain_english: Having made an altar with rice grains, one should then have the auspicious declaration recited.
